data_elements.name: Patient Insurance
data_elements.description: e This contains the patient’s insurance information like Patient Name, Insurance name, Plan ID, Group Number etc. There is no subfolder for this. 3032
fields: Insurance Type Code for Medicare as Secondary Insurance
notes: Only insurances with a status of active are exported.

data_elements.name: Vaccination
data_elements.description: n This exports the vaccine records that are administered using the options 'Vaccination on this visit' and 'Vaccination not associated with this visit'. The Scheduled vaccines are exported. The vaccines which are 'Not Tracked’ are not exported. Once the vaccine is inactivated in the vaccine it is not available for further selection. However, if this vaccine was administered then it does get exported.

data_elements.name: Health Maintenance
data_elements.description: e Health maintenance details are exported only for the tests which are in Due or Tentative states. The history is not exported. Type of tests for which data exported are: Lab / Rad / Consult / Procedure.

data_elements.name: Family History
data_elements.description: y All the latest family history data is exported for patients.

data_elements.name: Past Medical Hist
data_elements.description: t Past medical history data is exported as per the latest encounter status for the patients. Ailments are also exported.

data_elements.name: Surgery
data_elements.description: y This contains the surgical history records of the patient. This data is exported as per the face sheet data for the patient.

data_elements.name: Allergy
data_elements.description: y 3032 This contains the allergy data of the patient. This data is exported as per the face sheet data for the patient.

data_elements.name: Current Medication
data_elements.description: n Current medication data is exported as per the latest encounter status for the patients.

data_elements.name: Social History
data_elements.description: y This contains the social history records of the patient. Social history data is exported as per the latest encounter status for the patients.

data_elements.name: Legal Documents
data_elements.description: s This contains patient records which have one or more Legal Documents attached to their account in PrognoCIS. It typically lists patient’s basic information and the Legal record related information as input in PrognoCIS. If documents are HTML, then they are converted to PDF, else copied as is.

data_elements.name: Other Documents
data_elements.description: s This contains patient records which have one or more Other Documents attached to their record in PrognoCIS. It typically lists patient’s basic information and the Other Document related information as input in PrognoCIS.

data_elements.name: Enc Attach Docs
data_elements.description: s This contains patient records attached to their account in PrognoCIS. It typically lists patient’s basic information and the Other Document related information as input in PrognoCIS. Multiple attachments in an Encounter For ex. CHART01/DOCEN_23166.pdf Here, CHART01 is the folder and the DOCEN_23166 corresponds to the physical file stored under the Folder CHART01.

data_elements.name: Old Progress Notes
data_elements.description: s All the documents (Doc Type: OPA) attached to the patient account are exported. If documents are HTML, then they are converted to PDF, else copied as is. Along with the files attached, excel file is also exported with following fields.

data_elements.name: Messages
data_elements.description: s All the patient messages that are added to patient record from Message Compose screen.

data_elements.name: Future Appointments
data_elements.description: s All patient appointments (today and onwards) with status as Scheduled or Tentative are exported.

data_elements.name: Vitals
data_elements.description: s This contains the patient’s basic demographics information. We only export vitals recorded as per the latest encounter.
notes: We only export vitals recorded as per the latest encounter.

data_elements.name: Diagnosis Code
data_elements.description: e This is the list of diagnosis codes as per the assessment in patient’s encounter.

data_elements.name: CPT Codes
data_elements.description: s This is the list of CPT codes as per the assessment in patient’s encounter.

data_elements.name: HCPC Codes
data_elements.description: s This is the list of HCPC codes as per the assessment in patient’s encounter.

data_elements.name: CCD
data_elements.description: D This contains the CCD details.

data_elements.name: Prescriptions
data_elements.description: s This contains the Rx details of the patient. All the drugs ever prescribed for the patient in Prognocis are exported.

data_elements.name: Lab Results
data_elements.description: s All the received Lab Results will be exported.

data_elements.name: Rad Results
data_elements.description: s All the received Radiology Results will be exported.

data_elements.name: Procedure Orders
data_elements.description: s All procedure orders and results are exported.

data_elements.name: Consults
data_elements.description: s All patient consults are exported.

data_elements.name: Enc Progress Notes
data_elements.description: s This contains patient visit records. It typically lists patient’s basic information and the Visit/Encounter record related information available in PrognoCIS. The progress notes (My Notes) along with the attached progress notes are exported only for encounters that are closed. If there are multiple My Notes created then only the default My note gets exported.
fields: Date of the follow up encounter
Date on which the transcript is freezed
Refer To Doctor Federal tax ID

data_elements.name: Procedure Notes
data_elements.description: s This contains patient records which have Procedures attached to their account in PrognoCIS. Procedure notes documents for the non-zero duration encounters are exported.
notes: Please note that in order to be able to export procedure notes, print template

data_elements.name: Letters
data_elements.description: s This contains patient records which have one or more Letter-in and Letter-out records attached to their record. All the letters which are sent out with status ‘sent’ or incoming letters attached to the patient’s record are exported. Any attachments with the outgoing letter are NOT exported. 3032 If the letter is sent to multiple recipients then a consolidated PDF with multiple letters is generated. For A letter is sent To: Mary Smith and To: John Smith and CC: Mark Smithe then a single PDF is created with all the three letters. The excel sheet has the following details of the letters. In case of multiple recipients only one row is generated with the ‘To-From’ column displaying the first recipients name.
fields: List of To and Cc Names

data_elements.name: All Vitals
data_elements.description: s This contains Vitals for all Encounters.
fields: Chart No. Account No. Date Of Birt

data_elements.name: Lab Test Result Values
data_elements.description: s Lab results with status as ‘Received’ or ‘Complete’ are exported. This exports discrete result tests. – All the lab test results with status R & C will be exported. – Test results from Deleted encounters, DE/FS encounters are also exported. 3032
fields: The status set by the Doctor. Normal/Abnormal

data_elements.name: Patient Cases
data_elements.description: s Contains the list of Patients and their Cases.

data_elements.name: Patient Notes
data_elements.description: s All Patient Notes saved for a Patient in the NOTES table (Type: CN)

data_elements.name: Patient Alert
data_elements.description: t All Patients Alerts except the Alerts that are deleted. 3032

data_elements.name: Past Appointments
data_elements.description: s All Patient Appointments of current and previous dates with Visit Status Scheduled, Tentative, Arrived, With Nurse, With MA, For MA, With Doc, Complete, Ready for Nurse, Ready for Doc, Ready for Checkout, Ready for Review.

data_elements.name: Billing Ledger
data_elements.description: r Exports the Ledger for Run Date. Ledger will be exported for billed claims only. We do not export claim wise ledger.
notes: We do not export claim wise ledger.

data_elements.name: Billing Claims
data_elements.description: s Exports all Billed Claims for the Patient. Claims which are billed only those claims will be exported. Void claims will not be exported. UB04 data will NOT be exported – No CMS 1500 / UB04 forms will be exported.
notes: Void claims will not be exported.

data_elements.name: Billing Charges
data_elements.description: s Exports all Billed Claims and their Charges for the Patient. Void Charges are not exported.
fields: Tertiary Insurance Paid Amount Tertiary Insurance W/off Amount

data_elements.name: Patient Advance
data_elements.description: e Data of the Patient's Advance which is Moved to Advance or Opening Advance will be exported. Only billed claims data will be exported.

data_elements.name: Statements
data_elements.description: s Exports the Statement for Run Date. Latest Patient statement will be exported for billed claims only. For ex, If we have a statement generated for a patient Dummy test on 01-012017, 01-01-2018 and 01-01-2019. Then, the statement will get generated for 01-01-2019. Which is the latest. We do not export claim wise statements. File name with path - For ex. CHART01/STATEMENT_173141.pdf Here, CHART01 is the folder and the STATEMENT_173141 corresponds to the Patient ID. 3032
notes: We do not export claim wise statements. File name with path - For ex.
